contentPattern: One row per person. Cell 1: portrait image. Cell 2: name as a heading (h3/h4), role/title as a paragraph, and the link to the bio page (link text e.g. "Read more"; it also links the portrait and name).
usage: Leadership / directors listing pages: a grid of portrait cards (2 columns mobile, 3 at 991px, 4 at 1200px) each linking to a person bio page.
reuseGuidance: Use for any grid of people cards with portrait, name, role and bio link. For news or media tiles use cards-news or cards-gallery instead.
